The '''Primera Divisió''' (First Division), also known as '''Lliga Multisegur Assegurances''' for sponsorship reasons<ref name=":0" /> is the top level of men's [[Association football|football]] in [[Andorra]].

The league was launched in 1995 sponsored by the local federation ([[Andorran Football Federation]]) which was created just one year before. Until then, clubs had played since 1970 in an amateur league without a structure or affiliation with any official institution.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://bp3.blogger.com/_wUVU0K4QvaQ/RcSq0rzjSLI/AAAAAAAAABU/qZ9Xv3PA_P4/s1600-h/MACE1.JPG|title=MACE1.JPG (image)|website=bp3.blogger.com}}</ref> Since affiliation to [[UEFA]] and [[FIFA]] in 1996, Andorran clubs are able to compete in the [[UEFA competitions]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thefreelibrary.com/'HAIR+WE+GO,+HAIR+WE+GO..'+United+will+face+barber-ians;+CE+PRINCIPAT...-a061076898|title='HAIR WE GO, HAIR WE GO..' United will face barber-ians; CE PRINCIPAT v DUNDEE UTD. – Free Online Library|website=thefreelibrary.com}}</ref> Until 2015 the league was known as ''Lliga Grup Becier''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1006438&cod_primaria=3000301&cod_secundaria=3000301#.VgXYeCulpS4|title=FAF – Lliga Grup Becier: Nou patrocinador de la Primera Divisió de Futbol|website=faf.ad}}</ref> and during 2016 ''Lliga Grup Sant Eloi''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NNws_ShwNewDup?codigo=1006777&cod_primaria=3000301&cod_secundaria=3000301|title=FAF – Lliga Grup Sant Eloi: Nou patrocinador de la Primera Divisió de Futbol|website=faf.ad}}</ref> It was renamed in 2017 as '''Lliga Multisegur Assegurances''' for sponsorship reasons.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/59909/la-primera-divisio-passa-a-dir-se-lliga-multisegur-assegurances|title=La Primera Divisió passa a dir-se Lliga Multisegur Assegurances|website=elperiodic.ad|date=14 September 2017 }}</ref>

All the teams in the league play in the same stadiums owned by the federation. The same occurs in all other Andorran competitions, such as the [[Copa Constitució]] and [[Andorran Supercup|Supercopa]].

[[FC Andorra]], one of the major clubs in the country based in [[Andorra la Vella]], have never played in this league; they play in the Spanish league system, and are registered with the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation]].

==League system==
The eight clubs that play in the league play each other three times in the same venue. After the first 21 rounds, the league splits in half, into a top four and bottom four. They then play the other three teams in their section twice more to give a total of 27 games. The last placed of the relegation round is relegated to [[Segona Divisió]], the second highest football league in Andorra, while the penultimate classified play a two-legged relegation play-off against the runners-up of Segona Divisió. The number of teams of ''Primera Divisió'' has changed throughout the league's history:

*1995–96: 10 clubs
*1996–97: 12 clubs
*1997–98: 11 clubs
*1998–99: 12 clubs
*1999–00: 7 clubs
*2000–02: 8 clubs
*2002–03: 9 clubs
*2003–23: 8 clubs
*2023–''present'': 10 clubs

===Qualification for European competitions===
The winner of the league wins a place in the [[UEFA Champions League]] qualifications round, while the runners-up of the league and the [[Copa Constitució|Cup]] winner win a place in the [[UEFA Conference League]] qualifications round.

The [[Andorran Football Federation]] organizes the matches of ''Primera Divisió'' and ''Segona Divisió'' in the stadiums owned by the local federation.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NPcd/NFG_LstCampos?cod_primaria=1000122|title=FAF - Consulta de Terrenys de Joc|website=faf.ad}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://bondia.ad/esports/lestadi-comunal-torna-acollir-partits-de-primera-divisio-cinc-anys-despres|title=L'estadi Comunal torna a acollir partits de Primera Divisió cinc anys després|website=bondia.ad}}</ref> Also the federation distributes the stadiums and fields for the training sessions for each team.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.faf.ad/pnfg/NBdd_LstDocumentos?cod_primaria=3000342|title=FAF|website=faf.ad}}</ref> Since the 2016–17 season, [[FC Encamp]] is the only club that has its own stadium (✚), located in [[Encamp|Prada de Moles]] ([[Camp de Futbol d'Encamp]]).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fcencamp.org/el-club/instal-lacions.html|title=FC Encamp Web Oficial - FCEncamp.org - FCE|first=Web|last=Gestió|website=FC Encamp}}</ref> Until 2016 the [[Camp d’Esports d’Aixovall|Camp d'Esports d'Aixovall]] hosted former matches of ''Primera Divisió'' and ''Segona Divisió''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ara.ad/societat/Adeu-al-camp-futbol-dAixovall_0_1612638934.html|title=Adéu al camp de futbol d'Aixovall|website=ara.ad|date=13 July 2016 }}</ref>
